increment: Reader-only fix: stop a publication-gate ReviewItem from being mistaken for a source-contradiction ReviewItem in the reconcile dedupe. _pending_conflict_exists gains an opt-in source_contradiction_only flag that narrows the match with reason.like('evidence_conflict%'); the reconcile contradiction dedupe passes True, the two publisher call sites keep the broad any-pending-review-for-this-identity semantics they intend.
defect: Two producers write a ReviewItem carrying evidence_conflict['identity_key']: reconcile (reason 'evidence_conflict: ...', a source contradiction) and publisher (_raise_review, reason 'publication_gate: ...', a publication-gate hold). The reconcile dedupe reader _pending_conflict_exists filtered ONLY on admin_disposition=='pending' AND evidence_conflict['identity_key']==identity_key, with NO reason filter. Both producers populate identity_key, so a pending publisher item satisfied a query meaning 'a source contradiction is already pending for this identity'. Direction-of-harm CONFIRMED: the caller at _raise_contradiction_reviews does `if _pending_conflict_exists(...): continue`, so a false True SKIPS recording a genuine cross-source contradiction -> the contradiction is never recorded and an offer that should be held may stay published. Fixing it records MORE contradictions and holds MORE offers for review (safe direction, product-visible).
stale-ledger-refuted: The ledger claimed the reader depends on identity.provider/identity.service. It does NOT. That describes a DIFFERENT, already-correct sibling reader app.read_api.queries.fetch_conflicted_services, which discriminates via reason.like('evidence_conflict%'). The measured reader keys only on identity_key.
discriminator: reason.like('evidence_conflict%'), mirroring fetch_conflicted_services. Chosen over a new producer 'kind'/'type' column because the schema has NO such column (reason is the only discriminator without a migration), and a reader-only reason filter is correct on already-persisted rows immediately with no backfill and no producer-payload change.
publisher-178-owner-decision: app/publish/publisher.py:_build_conditions 'no_contradiction' (~line 178) also calls _pending_conflict_exists and is DELIBERATELY left broad (default source_contradiction_only=False). Narrowing it would let more candidates satisfy no_contradiction and push toward MORE auto-publishing (the dangerous direction). Flagged as a separate named owner-decision item, not silently changed.
impact-measurement: Measured on the live populated container (freetier-atlas-postgres-1, local ingest corpus: 7 providers, 36 sources -- NOT production). 27 pending review items, ALL of the publisher publication_gate shape and ALL carrying identity_key; 0 evidence_conflict (reconcile) items; therefore 0 ACTIVE collisions right now (a collision needs a genuine cross-source contradiction to coincide with a pending gate item on the same identity). No currently-published offer changes review state on this corpus. The finding is structural, not count-driven: those 27 identities each carry a live suppressor, so the next genuine contradiction on any of them would have been silently deduped away pre-fix.
proof: Load-bearing (reader): reverting the caller to source_contradiction_only=False makes test_reconcile_records_contradiction_despite_pending_publisher_item FAIL (review_items==0 vs 1) while precision + contract still pass. Restored.

Load-bearing (producer contract): rewording the publisher's real reason literal onto 'evidence_conflict...' makes the NAMED test_producer_reason_prefixes_are_the_dedupe_contract FAIL. Restored byte-exact (publisher.py has zero diff vs origin).
Collision centrepiece: test_reconcile_records_contradiction_despite_pending_publisher_item -- pending publisher item + genuine contradiction on the SAME identity -> contradiction now recorded.
Precision: test_reconcile_dedupes_duplicate_source_contradiction -- a duplicate SOURCE contradiction is still deduped (one pending contradiction per identity).

Two-sided contract: test_producer_reason_prefixes_are_the_dedupe_contract asserts each producer's ACTUAL emitted reason (captured from a real ReviewItem, not a literal) -- reconcile MUST start 'evidence_conflict', publisher MUST NOT (and starts 'publication_gate').
constraints: Reader-only: no migration, no producer payload change, no backfill.
Edits confined to _pending_conflict_exists and its reconcile call site (away from the concurrent parse_schedule_window / staleness slice).
publisher.py left byte-for-byte unchanged; publisher call sites keep broad semantics.
No fixture re-capture, no network, no npm; boundary files untouched. PR opened; MUST NOT be merged here.
acceptance: Reconcile integration suite green on live Postgres (16 passed).
Reader and producer-contract load-bearing proofs each fail the predicted named test, then restore green.

Full suite + ruff check + ruff format --check reported with collected counts; pre-existing environmental failures (populated-corpus test_publish_pipeline compact-magnitude + read_api) reproduce identically on a clean origin/main tree.
